name: Zhejiang Lante Optics Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Lante Optics Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells optical products in China and internationally. The company offers prisms, lenses, windows, and filters; micro prisms and micro glass sphere/aspheric lens; rearview mirrors, LOGO projectors, and automotive lens; substrate, carriers, packing, and etching wafers, as well as through glass via; small lens, PBS prisms, and etching glass. It also provides imaging glass aspherical lens, laser collimators, FSC lens, and optical communication lens; projection, TOF, low light level, and special industry lens; and MLA micro lens array lightcarpet, headlamps, and interior and safety projection.
